newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market is closed on Monday for a holiday. The market will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, three-month treasury bills closed at a yield of 2.50/2.45 percent compared with Thursday's yield of 2.54/2.49 percent but one-year was unchanged from Thursday's yield of 2.16/2.11 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$98.03/98.08 against Thursday's close of S$97.93/97.98, September 2001 at S$97.63/97.68 versus S$97.55/97.60 and June 2003 at S$96.57/96.62 from S$96.50/96.55.
The overnight interbank offered rate rose to 3-1/2 3-3/8 percent against Thursday's 3-1/4 3-1/8 percent.
